let pods = KubePodInventory | where Namespace == "default" and Name startswith "web-" | summarize by PodUid, PodName = Name;
Perf
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h) and ObjectName == "K8SContainer" and CounterName == "cpuUsageNanoCores"
| extend parts = split(InstanceName, "/")
| extend PodUid = tostring(parts[array_length(parts) - 2])
| join kind=inner pods on PodUid
| summarize CPU_pct_of_limit = avg(CounterValue) / 2000000 by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), PodName
| render timechart

let pods = KubePodInventory | where Namespace == "default" and Name startswith "web-" | summarize by PodUid, PodName = Name;
Perf
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h) and ObjectName == "K8SContainer" and CounterName == "memoryWorkingSetBytes"
| extend parts = split(InstanceName, "/")
| extend PodUid = tostring(parts[array_length(parts) - 2])
| join kind=inner pods on PodUid
| summarize Memory_MiB = avg(CounterValue) / 1048576 by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), PodName
| render timechart

AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| summarize Requests = sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| render columnchart

AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| summarize P95_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| render timechart

KubePodInventory
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h) and Namespace == "default" and Name startswith "web-" and PodStatus == "Running"
| summarize Replicas = dcount(PodUid) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| render timechart
